height.label: Height
height.note: How tall the photograph runs. The picture is cropped to fit, so a taller band shows more of it.

short.label: Strip
short.note: A slim strip of the photograph. A pause rather than a picture.

standard.label: Standard
standard.note: A proper band of photograph, about a third of a laptop screen. The default.

tall.label: Tall
tall.note: Most of a phone screen. For a photograph strong enough to hold that much room.
